messages:
Avery: Quick non-work poll — desert-island snack stack: you get exactly 3 snack items only. What are you bringing? 🤔
Rohit: Chocolate bars, trail mix, instant ramen. Shelf-life strategy. :ramen:
Zoe: Dried mango, almond butter packets, dark chocolate. (mango for nostalgia)
Ben: Salted caramel cookies, popcorn (movie mode), cheese crisps. Comfort calories. :popcorn:
Irene: Beef jerky, espresso sachets, peanut M&Ms. Coffee > everything.
lunch-bot: Reminder: free lunch in the kitchen at 12:30! :sandwich:
Avery: Coffee sachets are cheating but I'm voting Irene's list. Also who sneaks a tiny portable speaker? :headphones:
Zoe: Speaker is banned. :laughing:
Ben: Trade offer: my popcorn for Zoe's dried mango. :handshake:
